waterhouse_circe_invidiosa_20261025_0215.story: Eleven motivated compositions: face and bowl, flowing poison, early complete reveal, poisoned water, cold gaze, hands, darkness, cloth, water shapes, return to the figure, still full painting. No ghosting, no repeated arbitrary details, no camera oscillation.

scenes.intent: Circe's face and emerald bowl form one tense opening question
The narrow poison stream slips over her hands and the upper robe
An early full composition reveals the solitary figure standing above the poisoned sea
Her bare feet, dark shapes below and green ripples reveal the consequence of the act
Her downward gaze becomes colder once the sea has been revealed
Both hands support the wide shallow vessel that holds the green poison
Brown upper darkness isolates the figure from any visible human witness
The painted green robe and liquid form a continuous downward visual line
The sea below her feet contains uncanny forms beneath green rings of water
Hands, face and descending stream reunite before the moral aftermath
A still whole-painting finale leaves the viewer with the color of envy
